mapper.select: select B.bom_id as bomId, I.item_id as itemId, I.item_code as code, I.item_name as name, B.require_qty as unit, (SELECT '/display?fileName=' || IMG.img_location || IMG.img_name FROM item_img IMG WHERE IMG.item_id = I.item_id AND IMG.rep_img_yn = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) as imgUrl from bom B join item I on B.parent_item_id = I.item_id where B.child_item_id = #{childItemId}
